results: Guest is invited to sign in; cart and delivery choice survive. Empty address book blocks delivery checkout.
Add-modal/map nesting works; two destinations select their own recipient/address/pin, draft restores selection and pickup/delivery retains it.
Online order snapshots survive address edits/deletion; management supports edit/remove/default, default promotion and empty-after-delete.
POS requires a customer and saved destination, supports modal add for empty/multiple books and clears stale coordinates when choosing an unpinned address.
A delayed address response after switching customers cannot replace the current customer destination.
Save failure keeps entered fields; pending save disables repeated submission/close and retry saves/selects the address.
Failed POS address load cannot retain the old customer destination; retry recovers and sale receipt records the chosen address/pin.
Creating a POS customer imports their first address and selects it; switching customers reloads only that customer book.
Server validation errors retain the modal fields and allow cancel/retry.
Cart/POS/address management and modal controls fit six narrow/wide/short viewports; Escape and focus restoration work.
scope: Isolated SQLite, Chrome; synthetic OSM tiles and mocked GPS, no physical-device verification.
